# Optimeta — AI Meta Ad Campaign Architect

## What is Optimeta?
Optimeta (optimeta.tech) is India's first AI-powered Meta ad campaign architect. It transforms business information into complete, ready-to-launch Facebook and Instagram campaign blueprints in minutes.

## Who is it for?
- Indian D2C brands
- SaaS founders
- Coaches and consultants
- Local service businesses
- Marketing freelancers
- Agencies

## What problem does it solve?
Most Indian brands waste money on Meta ads because they run campaigns without strategy. Marketing agencies charge ₹50,000+ per month for basic campaign plans. Generic AI tools like ChatGPT do not understand Indian audience behavior, INR economics, or India-specific funnel dynamics.

## What does Optimeta generate?
Each campaign blueprint includes:
- Campaign objective recommendation
- Funnel strategy (TOFU/MOFU/BOFU)
- Budget split logic with daily amounts in INR
- Audience targeting: 10 specific interests, 6 behaviors, demographic filters
- 2 detailed targeting combinations
- Ad set structure with naming conventions
- 4 ad angles (pain, desire, trust, social proof)
- 3 complete ad copies (Feed, Reel, Story)
- Creative direction with UGC brief
- Pixel and tracking recommendations
- 8-step launch checklist
- First 7 days action plan
- Performance benchmarks (ROAS, CTR, CPM, CPC)

## Pricing
- Free: 1 campaign blueprint (lifetime)
- Pro: ₹499/month — 5 blueprints per month
- Ultra: ₹999/month — 10 blueprints per month

## India-specific knowledge
Optimeta is built specifically for India:
- All budgets in INR
- COD (Cash on Delivery) strategy included
- Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 city targeting
- Indian audience behavior patterns
- India 2026 benchmarks:
  CPM ₹60-120 metro, ₹30-70 Tier 2/3
  Feed CTR 1.5-3%, Reels CTR 3-6%
  Fashion ROAS 2.4x-4.0x
  Beauty ROAS 2.8x-4.5x
